// Package ledger posts entries.
package ledger

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
)

// ErrClosed means that the period is closed.
var ErrClosed = errors.New("ledger: the period is closed")

// Entry is one posting.
type Entry struct {
	Account string
	Cents   int64
}

// Post writes an entry.
func Post(ctx context.Context, e Entry) error {
	if e.Cents == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return nil
}
